413:t_3:43.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Of course. You have to decide your own path.」

413:t_3:45.en:
$$レド$$
(There's no need to talk about the truth of the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ now. I can keep it to myself until the time comes...)

413:t_3:46.en:
$$アルト$$
「Sorry to interrupt the touching reunion, but the Captain is fuming.」

413:t_3:48.en:
$$レド$$
「Major $$オズマ$$... I'm sorry for acting on my own, alone, on my own judgment.」

413:t_3:49.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Is that all you have to say, Ensign $$レド$$?」

413:t_3:50.en:
$$レド$$
「...I'm no longer a soldier of the $$人類銀河同盟$$. No... I'm a man who has been disqualified from being a soldier.」

413:t_3:51.en:
$$オズマ$$
「How do you intend to live from now on?」

413:t_3:52.en:
$$レド$$
「I'm not a soldier, but I will keep fighting. For the things I want to protect, and to find out how I should live from now on.」

413:t_3:54.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Very well, $$レド$$. Then I'll train you from scratch.」

413:t_3:55.en:
$$オズマ$$
「As a human being... as a man.」

413:t_3:57.en:
$$桂$$
「Even a drifter like you finally has a place to truly return to.」

413:t_3:58.en:
$$レド$$
「$c... And the $$ガルガンティア船団$$...」

413:t_3:59.en:
$$桂$$
「No, no. Your place to return to is wherever $$エイミー$$ is.」

413:t_3:61.en:
$$モーム$$
「We heard every word. $$エイミー$$'s 'I want to be by your side' declaration.」

413:t_3:63.en:
$$桂$$
「How, you ask... Chamber relayed it, of course.」

413:t_3:65.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「To convey the situation accurately, I picked up the audio and sent it to $c.」

413:t_3:66.en:
$$レド$$
「Was there a problem, $$エイミー$$?」

413:t_3:67.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Um, well... It's not that there's a problem, but...」

413:t_3:68.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$桂$$... I'm counting on you to coach him on that front.」

413:t_3:70.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't quite understand, but I'm counting on you. I want to get closer to $$エイミー$$.」

413:t_3:72.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$ has already been released from the control of the $$人類銀河同盟$$. Therefore, everything is free.」

413:t_3:74.en:
$$アルト$$
「How you fly through that sky is up to you.」

413:t_3:75.en:
$$桂$$
「Come on... let's go see everyone. Not just $$エイミー$$, but $$宗介$$, $n, and the rest have been worried about you all along.」

413:t_3:77.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Hold it! Have you forgotten about me?!」

413:t_3:80.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Of course. With my repair skills, honed at $c, I fully restored the treasure.」

413:t_3:81.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Use that as a weapon, and shutting up those fleet guys is a piece of cake.」

413:t_3:82.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Oh my... how spirited. And yet most of your prized treasure was destroyed in that battle.」

413:t_3:84.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「But I don't care about that. In this wide world, there must be treasure sleeping somewhere that makes that stuff look like nothing.」

413:t_3:85.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I'm coming too, $$レド$$! I'll travel the world with $c and find something even more amazing!」

413:t_3:86.en:
$$レド$$
「So you've found a new way to live too.」

413:t_3:87.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Hearing the word treasure, I can't stay quiet. May I come along as well?」

413:t_3:88.en:
$$エイミー$$
「The great pirate $$ラケージ$$ too?!」

413:t_3:89.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「My subordinates took quite a beating in that battle as well.」

413:t_3:90.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Don't worry about them. $$リジット$$ says she'll look after them, along with the $$クーゲル$$ Fleet guys.」

413:t_3:91.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「In that case, my pirating days are over... Then setting out on a treasure-hunting journey with $$ピニオン$$ wouldn't be bad at all.」

413:t_3:94.en:
$$オズマ$$
「In that case, you're welcome, $$ラケージ$$. I'll look after you, along with $$ピニオン$$, the whole lot.」

413:t_3:95.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Thank you. ...First, I must pay my respects to the new Empress of the Sea here.」

413:t_3:97.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Would you show me the way?」

413:t_3:99.en:
$$アルト$$
「The $$残されの海$$ will be quiet now, but the storms will go on for $c...」

413:t_3:101.en:
$$アルト$$
「Are you all right now, $$ブレラ$$?」

413:t_3:102.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Yes... I underwent a detailed examination, and the function in my body for receiving external signals has been completely destroyed.」

413:t_3:103.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Now the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ can never control me again.」

413:t_3:105.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「...Then let me say just one thing.」

413:t_3:107.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I retract what I said before, that you are not worthy of $$ランカ$$.」

413:t_3:110.en:
$$桂$$
「Looks like you got Big Bro No. 2's seal of approval.」

413:t_3:112.en:
$$桂$$
「No. 1 has long since acknowledged you, so there are no obstacles left now...」

413:t_3:113.en:
$$桂$$
「All that's left is how you feel.」

413:t_3:115.en:
$$桂$$
「It's just as you told $$レド$$. ...It all depends on you.」

413:t_3:116.en:
$$桂$$
「Whether you choose one, or neither... whatever the outcome, just don't leave yourself with regrets.」

413:t_3:119.en:
$$桂$$
「I'll teach you properly sometime. It's about men and women.」

413:t_3:121.en:
$$レド$$
「Is there some problem, $$エイミー$$?」
